text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, compose music, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. They ask an important question: can a machine really be creative? AI learns from millions of examples and produces something new, but it does not have feelings or personal experiences. Human creativity comes from emotions, imagination, and life experience. AI can support artists by giving them new ideas, but it cannot replace the human touch. Perhaps the best results happen when people and machines work together.
